scope: Standalone private operator apps; finite same-origin browser error ingress; one Java JVM

operator_config.plaintext_secret_file_mode: 0400; readable only by the official GlitchTip container UID5000
operator_config.operator_url: http://localhost:18880 via loopback or authenticated tunnel; existing TLS ingress may terminate before it

limits.cpu_sampling: ITIMER 10ms; uploads10s; stack depth256; allocation/lock off; queue2; one Attendance JVM
limits.native_measurements: Pending the isolated ordinary CI job; limits are not measured consumption

pmm.additional_benefit_considered: PostgreSQL statement-level aggregate latency/plan history and MongoDB query-shape analytics would add diagnosis beyond health/resource exporters. The selected 18-week operation is CPU/ZIP/XML rendering and has no demonstrated statement-level bottleneck.
pmm.privacy_and_access: QAN needs statement/profiler collection and additional database access/configuration. Normalized text/query shapes and examples need a separate privacy decision; no such grants or data collection added.
pmm.resources: A server plus agents adds another storage/retention and RAM/CPU budget. No PMM benchmark was run and no unsupported memory estimate is treated as measured. Existing Prometheus PostgreSQL/Mongo exporters and Grafana remain active.
pmm.reconsider_when: A concrete slow SQL/Mongo operation remains unexplained after current latency, exporter, trace and scoped CPU diagnostics.

capacity_qualification: Actual Cloud is 16GiB RAM/4 CPU quota with a 4GiB disk floor; a future 32GiB VPS is not current capacity or measured acceptance.
